race.comment: AUTUMN SLIDE (4) just gets the nod after an encouraging return at Cranbourne, finishing second over 1400m when held up passing the 200m and beaten just under a length. Fitter now for the rise in trip and D Lane on offsets the wide gate. STUNG (2) is a clear danger, fitter third-up after being beaten two lengths at Geelong and drawing barrier 1 for Craig Williams and the Hayes stable. Her form last time in reads well. JENNI YOU THINK (19) keeps finding the frame, placed at her past four. Lands in a trailing position from the low gate and can break through. CHIRINGITA (5) resumes from an eight-month break with three trials behind her, including a close second at Cranbourne. She's got upside and is worth keeping an eye on.
